overlooked_assumption: The agent assumed the webhook URL stored in the database was the correct Zapier catch hook URL, without checking whether the URL format or path structure had changed or was being normalized differently when stored versus when used in outbound requests.
why_it_breaks: The seed script stores the webhook URL as provided, but the outbound webhook sender likely normalizes or transforms the URL (e.g., stripping trailing slashes, lowercasing, or path encoding) before sending to Zapier. When the stored URL doesn't match the normalized format Zapier expects, every request returns 404 "hook not found". The agent overlooked that URL storage and URL transmission may use different formatting rules, so the persisted value appears correct to the admin but is functionally wrong at request time.
